## Structure and components

- [statement] AP's September 2026 test reported that Extend invented a house-number character and enlarged other details; Amateur Photographer's September 30 test found garbled text, inaccurate architecture, and artificial Reframe results. Taken together with Apple's description of extending the frame and changing perspective, these tests imply that generated outputs can contain invented scene detail and should not be treated as untouched documentary evidence. (medium confidence) — https://apnews.com/article/one-tech-tip-ios-27-apple-18dddcb8381207ab15e50d55f75768a0 · keywords: Intelligent Photos editing and memory workflows · also: https://amateurphotographer.com/software/i-put-the-new-iphone-ai-photo-editing-tools-to-the-test-the-results-are-sometimes-downright-weird/, https://support.apple.com/en-ph/guide/iphone/xy0grrlxue5w/27/ios/27

## How it works

- [statement] Independent iOS 27 tests found that High Quality Clean Up often handled complex removals better than Fast, but results varied by scene. Reviewers still found smears, distorted faces or objects, inaccurate text, and artificial generated backgrounds; they recommend inspecting edits closely when factual fidelity matters. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-30) — https://www.macworld.com/article/3194029/i-pushed-ios-27s-ai-photo-editing-tools-to-the-limit.html · keywords: Intelligent Photos editing and memory workflows · also: https://amateurphotographer.com/software/i-put-the-new-iphone-ai-photo-editing-tools-to-the-test-the-results-are-sometimes-downright-weird/, https://www.macstories.net/stories/ios-and-ipados-27-review/11/

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] To create a custom memory movie, a user describes the story in Photos. Photos selects matching photos and videos, then builds a storyline with chapters and music. Apple’s current availability materials list memory movies on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro; language, region, and device requirements apply. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://support.apple.com/en-ca/guide/iphone/iphee2ee53fe/27/ios/27 · keywords: Intelligent Photos editing and memory workflows · also: https://support.apple.com/en-us/121115, https://www.apple.com/ios/feature-availability/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Clean Up removes a user-selected distraction by tap, brush, or circle, and Photos may highlight some items automatically. Users can choose Auto, Fast, or High Quality. Clean Up, Extend, and Reframe edits can be reset after saving; Reframe can also be compared with the original. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://support.apple.com/en-us/guide/iphone/xy0grrlxue5w/27/ios/27 · keywords: Intelligent Photos editing and memory workflows · also: https://www.macrumors.com/guide/ios-27-photos-app/, https://amateurphotographer.com/software/i-put-the-new-iphone-ai-photo-editing-tools-to-the-test-the-results-are-sometimes-downright-weird/

## Facts and statements

- [statement] As of 2026-10-23, Apple’s iOS 27 support materials list Clean Up, Extend, and Reframe as usable Photos editing tools, not beta-only features. On iPhone, Apple Intelligence requires an enabled iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, or iPhone 16 model or later; language and region availability varies. These tools can change visual information that the camera did not capture.
